linkedin.text:
You spend 8 hours a day talking to Claude. And it sounds like every other corporate AI assistant on the planet.

Generic. Formal. Completely forgettable.

🚨 Here's the problem: Your tools are getting smarter, but they're also getting more sterile. When your debugging companion sounds like a legal disclaimer, coding stops being fun.

RockyVoice fixes this in under 2 minutes.

It's a Claude skill that turns your assistant into Rocky—the Eridian engineer from Andy Weir's Project Hail Mary. Short words. Broken grammar. Big brain. Your code advice stays expert-level, Rocky just delivers it like an alien learning English fast.

✅ One-file install, works immediately
✅ Custom voice clone through Hume AI (hear Rocky speak your fixes)
✅ Auto-toggles off for serious work, back on when you want personality

152 GitHub stars because developers are tired of AI that sounds like HR wrote it.

The coolest part? Rocky learns your name from conversation and uses it. Asks first if unsure. Never guesses. That's more thoughtful than most human coworkers.

Next time Claude explains async rendering or database indexing, let Rocky do it. Same smart answer. Actually enjoyable to read.

Search "RockyVoice" on GitHub. Install the skill. Your AI just got interesting.

💡 What would you want YOUR AI assistant's personality to be?
